messages:
anya (PM): FYI customer BrightLeaf hit a regression on the streaming chat path after last week's rollout. Seeing intermittent 502s during long sessions. Can we triage?

matt (eng-runtime): saw the alert. stack traces point at the KV-cache eviction codepath when prefix size > 128KB. repro locally with long context.

dan (cs): customer reports it happens ~1-2x per 1000 requests, mostly on >4k token sessions. It's impacting a few paying customers. They want a quick remediation plan.

sophie (eng-sre): current p50 latency ok but p95 spikes and error-rate from that node pool up to 0.8% during peak. Would prefer a mitigant before a deeper fix.

liz (product): we need to decide bug vs enhancement. Business asks: fast fix to stop errors, but also don't ship risky hack. Propose: hotfix rollback to previous kv-cache threshold + follow-on architectural fix in next sprint.

matt (eng-runtime): quick mitigation options: 1) bump cache eviction threshold (low risk, quick), 2) fallback to non-streaming path when context > N (more intrusive), 3) patch bug in eviction logic (safe but needs test + perf run). I estimate 1-day for option 1, 3 days for option 3.

sophie (eng-sre): option 1 seems safest short-term. We can monitor and auto-roll if error rate persists. Add a deploy-bot canary.

dan (cs): customers will accept a config change if we communicate clearly and offer a follow-up timeline. I'll draft the message.

anya (PM): proposed plan: A) Immediate: option 1 hotfix config rollback to previous threshold + canary rollout (owner: matt, ETA 6 hrs). B) Short-term: safety patch to eviction logic with unit+integration tests (owner: matt, ETA 3 days). C) Next iteration: broader stress test + KV design review (owner: eng-runtime, ETA next sprint). D) Acceptance criteria: errors <=0.1% and p95 latency drop <10% from baseline for 48h post-rollout.

matt (eng-runtime): ack. I'll open a PR for the config change now and link test plan.

sophie (eng-sre): I'll set up a canary on two nodes and alert thresholds: error-rate >0.3% AND p95 up 20% -> auto rollback.

dan (cs): I'll notify BrightLeaf (transparency + workaround) and offer a postmortem when we have the patch.

liz (product): for backlog/grooming: mark the patch as P0 bug with acceptance criteria above, add the architectural follow-up story as P2 enhancement (include load test and observability tasks). We'll re-evaluate after hotfix.

anya (PM): scheduling: hotfix today, patch ship by EOD Wednesday, groom epics in Fri triage. Anyone blocking?

matt (eng-runtime): no blockers, just need a test infra window for perf runs tomorrow morning.

sophie (eng-sre): will reserve the window and coordinate with infra.

deploy-bot: deploy started (canary=2/2).

anya (PM): thanks all. I'll follow up with timeline and write the brief for Friday's grooming.

matt (eng-runtime): will post PR and short repro steps in the thread.

dan (cs): adding customer impact note to the ticket and scheduling a sync with BrightLeaf for tomorrow.

liz (product): great - reassigning stories and tagging for the sprint. :thumbsup:

anya (PM): closing the loop: owner list: matt (hotfix + patch), sophie (canary + alerts), dan (customer comms), liz (prioritization), anya (PM). We'll log a postmortem after patch verification.
